We are the first certified creative/retail Business Incubator in the state of Oklahoma, which means participating tenants can get up to 10-years of state income tax waived! Additionally, we were recognized by the Urban Land Institute as top 3 projects in the state for our impact in Sustainability for having built more than a third of the interior from repurposed materials. The Concept Sailor & The Dock is a local market, bar, arts and events venue in an eco-conscious conversion of a 1920s urban warehouse.
